digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend transport / reconciler port conformance
propositions: DC transport is missing twelve methods the core calls, causing silent degradation in seven call sites and crashes in others when a writing reconcile pass executes

DC transport members raise JiraDataCenterTransport.AttributeError instead of being absent, but most call sites swallow all exceptions, so failures go unobserved and the pass appears to converge while comments, links, parents, and properties are silently not synced

DC's reporter sync will re-emit mutations forever because inbound_fields._identity_of reads only accountId (which DC does not have), so DC reporter snapshots always yield account_id=None and never match the desired state
TicketTransport protocol is not @runtime_checkable so isinstance checks raise TypeError, making it impossible to guard against missing members at backend construction time
DC REST v2 uses offset pagination (startAt/maxResults) while Cloud v3 uses cursor pagination (nextPageToken), so copying Cloud's get_parent_map implementation directly causes HTTP 400 rejects on DC
